Ref

  • CURIE: gmeow:Ref
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Ref
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software

A version-control reference — the generic superclass of Branch and any other named pointer into the commit graph.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:InformationObject

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:Ref as a specialized kind of gmeow:InformationObject. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
